scientific_limitations: Centered circular disks in distinct two-dimensional planes of Euclidean three-space; positive radii; angle in (0,pi/2]. At the planar degenerate endpoint the ordinary ambient boundary area is not equal to the one-sided three-dimensional surface-area limit. Other curves, translations, and more summands are unproved. Differently indexed prior derivations may exist.
title: A logarithmic coplanar transition for the surface area of two-disc discotopes
